About Open Arms

Healing Families & Empowering Communities

Open Arms Initiative is an Oklahoma City-based non-profit and clinical service provider focused on trauma-informed therapy, foster parent empowerment, and community mental health training.

OUR STORY & VISION

Supporting families,
healing children.

Every child deserves to grow up feeling secure, valued, and loved. For children and families navigating systemic trauma, foster placement, or emotional challenges, accessing qualified trauma-informed care can be life-changing.

Our team of licensed therapists, social workers, and clinical advocates work tirelessly to eliminate barriers to care through individual therapy, parenting courses, foster family guidance, and pro-bono programs.

OUR PILLARS

Core Values driving our mission

01

Compassion First

Every client's journey is unique. We meet families where they are with non-judgmental, empathetic care.

02

Clinical Excellence

We utilize evidence-based trauma models (CBT, attachment-based therapy, play therapy) tailored to individual needs.

03

Community Accessibility

Through pro-bono care, school workshops, and 24/7 foster support, we ensure mental health resources reach everyone.
